newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse suspends trade in Delta.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse suspends trade in Delta.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand said on Tuesday it had suspended trading of Delta Electronics (Thailand) Plc after halting trading in the shares for the morning session.
The suspension followed a report that some of the firm's employees had protested on Monday against a new welfare scheme and year-end bonus.
A company spokesman had told Reuters that the firm's production had stopped as about 1,000 workers had gone on strike.
A union official told Reuters that company management on Tuesday had agreed to meet its demand for higher year-end bonuses and that all employees had returned to work.

A Delta spokesman confirmed that agreement had been reached and that several classes of workers would be paid bonuses equal to two to three months of pay, compared with one to two months of pay offered earlier by the company.
"The demands from the workers have been met and all workers returned to work," he said.
The stock exchange said it had suspended trading in Delta shares pending further information from the company.
